reason: Cutting the marked paper is the only offered action and should start the breeze-powered toy.
expectation: I expect the scissors to cut the paper into a shape suitable for assembly, though I don't know exactly what shape.

effect: The cuts produced four blades, so gathering them at the hub looks like the next assembly step.
reaction: The blade shape makes the intended moving toy clearer.
reason: The hub is the only offered combination and should bring the blades together.
expectation: I expect the hub to gather the blade corners into a pinwheel shape.

effect: The gathered corners form curved pockets for the breeze to push, clarifying how the rotor works.
reaction: That physical explanation makes the assembly satisfying.
reason: The axle is the only offered combination and should let the rotor turn.
expectation: I expect the axle and spacer to support the rotor while leaving it free to spin.

effect: The rotor is now mounted on an axle, ready to attach to the handle.
reaction: The assembly is progressing as expected.
reason: The handle is the only offered combination and should make the rotor usable.
expectation: I expect the axle to clip onto the handle, forming a handheld pinwheel.

effect: The rotor is now attached to the handle, ready to test.
reaction: The pinwheel came together as expected.
reason: The fan is the only offered combination and should test whether the pinwheel turns.
expectation: I expect the fan's breeze to spin the pinwheel.

effect: The fan test confirmed that the spaced axle lets the blades spin freely, and the garden breeze also turns them.
reaction: Jo reaching for a turn is a pleasing payoff, though the result was expected.

mostWorthwhile.text: Gathering the blades was most worthwhile: the explanation of curved pockets showed how the breeze pushes the rotor, making the construction more than a sequence of parts.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the handle was straightforward progress, but it added little explanation or decision-making.

surprise.text: The explanation that the folded paper forms pockets for the breeze clarified how the rotor works.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though each step offered only one combination, so there was little room to make meaningful choices.

continue.text: I might continue for more explanations of how the toys work, but I would hope for more meaningful choices than this introductory build offered.
